cli.bring_in.other_participant: Operation {n} names a statement of {other}'s, and these are {who}'s LPETs, which take {who}'s statements alone.
cli.bring_in.not_theirs: Operation {n} names {statement}, which is not one of {who}'s statements at any of their timepoints. These LPETs take {who}'s statements alone.
cli.bring_in.not_a_statement: Operation {n} names {statement}, which is not one of {whose} statements.
cli.bring_in.on_board_in: Operation {n} brings in {statement}, which is on the board already, in '{label}'. A move takes it elsewhere.
cli.bring_in.on_board_loose: Operation {n} brings in {statement}, which is on the board already, in no {unit}. A move takes it into one.
cli.bring_in.on_board_aside: Operation {n} brings in {statement}, which is on the board already, set aside.
cli.bring_in.twice: Operations {first} and {n} both bring in {statement}. Bring it in once.
cli.bring_in.no_label: Operation {n} brings {statement} into {to}, which is no {unit} on this board. Name one by its id or its title as gets show gives them, or leave "to" out to bring it in to none.
cli.copy_lines.the_copy_took_words_and_q: The {name}' copy of the participant {verb} the new words and quotes
cli.copy_lines.the_copy_took_quotes: The {name}' copy of the participant {verb} the new quotes
cli.board_text.stale_cards: {cards} on this board read otherwise than the workbook, each marked card stale. copies refresh brings them in line.
cli.copies_refresh.nothing: Every board's cards and every copy of the statements read as the workbook does. Nothing to change.
cli.copies_refresh.dry_run: Dry run, nothing was written. {cards}, {statements} and {quotes} would be brought in line with the workbook.
cli.copies_refresh.wrote: Brought {cards}, {statements} and {quotes} in line with the workbook.
cli.copies_refresh.cards_missing: {cards} whose statement is no longer in the workbook, left on the board ({keys})
cli.copies_refresh.statements_missing: {statements} no longer in the workbook, left in the copy ({keys})
cli.copies_refresh.board_missing: {cards} on {board} whose statement is no longer in the workbook, left there ({keys})
cli.copies_refresh.bold_moved: {n} of his bold moved to the same words in the new quote
cli.copies_refresh.bold_moved_dry: {n} of his bold would move to the same words in the new quote
cli.copies_refresh.bold_dropped: his bold left off where the words are gone from the new quote: {n}, look at this cell
cli.copies_refresh.changed_mark: A card the PETs screen marks Changed takes the workbook's words too: Idiograph cannot tell a change he has yet to look at from a card a write left behind, so the workbook wins.
cli.copies_refresh.history: Each board it changed keeps the board as it stood first in its History, as "{history}", and is marked as changed in a conversation.
